The leaf shows dark, sooty, irregular black spots and patches scattered across the surface, with no powdery white coating, no necrotic lesions with defined margins, and no tip/margin dieback. The black deposits appear superficial and sooty in texture, consistent with a fungal growth on honeydew secretions.
